# ThemeProvider

Group: Foundations. Import: `import { ThemeProvider } from 'lynn-ui';`

The recommended root wrapper: renders the `.lynn-root` element every component's CSS expects and stamps `data-lynn-theme` onto it, which is what re-points the `--lynn-color-*` neutrals at a different mode.
 The selected mode persists to `localStorage` under `lynn-ui-theme`.

## Usage

Mount exactly one, as high in the tree as the stylesheet import - every component's CSS resolves its `--lynn-color-*` neutrals off the `.lynn-root` element this renders, so a subtree mounted outside it falls back to whatever the ambient page defines. `defaultTheme` is a first-run value only: once anything has written `lynn-ui-theme`, the stored mode wins on every later mount.

## Don't

Don't nest a second `ThemeProvider` to theme one subtree differently - both write the same `lynn-ui-theme` key, so the inner one's choice leaks out to the whole app on the next reload. And don't ship `defaultTheme` as a way to force a mode back; it cannot override a stored value, and there is no `prefers-color-scheme` fallback to lean on either.

Live: https://erick-nice.github.io/nice-designer-suite-website/lynn.html#themeprovider
